crossRefs.note: whose harvest the hungry eats up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.
They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.
I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes…
You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You…
You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave…
So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but…
His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

translations.web: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
translations.bsb: then may another eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.
translations.kjv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
translations.asv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; Yea, let the produce of my field be rooted out.
